spectralBound.formula: sum_j w_j exp(-(Delta+epsilon_j)t/hbar) <= exp(-Delta*t/hbar) sum_j w_j
spectralBound.proof: For each j, -(Delta+epsilon_j)t/hbar <= -Delta*t/hbar. Monotonicity of exp and w_j>=0 preserve the inequality, and finite summation preserves it.
spectralBound.periodicScope: The inequality bounds the forward term only; the backward periodic image is displayed separately.

spectral.inequalityDirection: gap_global <= E_channel <= m_eff for a positive zero-temperature spectral measure orthogonal to the entire vacuum space; periodic cosh output is a channel estimator.
